antidote.name: Full Heal
antidote.description: Cures one Pokémon of any status condition.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: Revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring half its max HP.

rare-candy.name: Rare Candy
rare-candy.description: A candy packed with energy. Raises a Pokémon's level by one.

poke-ball.name: Pokeball
poke-ball.description: A device for catching wild Pokémon.

escape-rope.name: Escape Rope
escape-rope.description: Returns you to the entrance of a cave or dungeon.
